note: Family-run private campground on 20 acres of Pacific bluff on the ocean side of Hwy 1 between Stillwater Cove and Salt Point SP, about 16 mi north of Jenner: more than 100 dry sites, some on the open bluff above the rocky cove and others back in the trees, with chemical toilets, a store and a boat ramp down to the cove. Trails run along the shore to Stillwater Cove. --Claude
summary: Ocean Cove: operator confirms FCFS, $40 cash / $45 card per vehicle, no hookups, RVs to 40 ft, water + showers + store; Google 4.6 (481). No long-stay/age wording, under the gate. Waterfront: propose bayview -> coastal walk (bluff camp on the ocean side of Hwy 1 with the boat ramp an easy walk to the cove shore). Season (Apr 1 - Nov 30, derived) not on the current site.
flags: WATERFRONT: propose bayview -> coastal walk (UPGRADE, reviewer call). Not bayfront: the RV sites sit atop a rocky cliff ~40-60 m from the surf (no walkable apron - the old evidence stands for on-water). But the coastal-walk test (AWH 2026-11-11: an easy walk to the shore of an ocean, any setting incl. rocky shore; a highway between rules it out) is met: Hwy 1 runs on the EAST side of the property (operator: 'entrance is directly off Highway 1 on the ocean side of the road'); on imagery the boat-ramp road drops ~150 m from the camp road (~38.5541,-123.3040) to the cove beach (~38.5550,-123.3036), and shore trails run to Stillwater Cove. 'bayview' also misnames an open-Pacific cove. Sites nearest the bluff edge: the RVs at ~38.5535,-123.3042 / ~38.5533,-123.3043 on the 150 m frame.
PRICE GATE: $40 cash / $45 card per vehicle before tax - under US$50. No gateway within 40 km.
LONG-STAY: no seasonal, monthly, minimum-stay or age wording on any page; FCFS transient camping.
SEASON: stored Apr 1 - Nov 30 (derived from an old note) is not on the current site; not confirmed, not rewritten. Reviewer may want a call or a Google-hours check before the next winter.
PHONE: (707) 847-3422 KEPT - contact page, tel: link, Google and the group-reservation line all agree; the site header's '707-884-3422' looks like a typo.
PIN: stored 38.55490,-123.30150 is at the store/office; Google 38.55519,-123.30089 (~60 m). Camp loops extend ~150-350 m south of it - OK under 250 m to the nearest loop.
